# [WP Workbench version 2.1.2 released](https://forum.virtualmin.com/t/wp-workbench-version-2-1-2-released/136980)

April 10, 2026, 11:35pm 1


Howdy all,


We’ve rolled out WP Workbench 2.1.2 plugin for all Virtualmin Pro users.


Changes since 2.1.1:


- Add automatic WP-CLI installation when refreshing instances if missing
- Fix JSON parsing when WP-CLI emits PHP warnings to stdout
- Fix backup form submission to work when opened through a remote link


Changes since 2.1.0:


- Fix the icons used in the system information on the dashboard
